data.one_liner: Shows a customizable lock screen on app open, pause, and inactive states.
data.what_it_does: Shows a lock screen widget when the application launches or returns from the background/inactive state. It prevents access to the underlying app content until a successful unlock action is triggered. It also supports background lock latency and inactive state builders.
use_when: You need to secure your app with a passcode, PIN, or biometric lock screen on startup and resume.
You want to hide sensitive app contents when the user opens the device app switcher.
avoid_when: You need backend authentication services or OAuth flows rather than a UI app lock overlay.
strengths: Integrates easily into MaterialApp, CupertinoApp, or WidgetsApp builders.
Supports background lock latency and custom inactive state builders.
Allows passing launch arguments from the unlock screen to the rest of the app.
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation of the actual login/authentication logic inside your own lock screen widget.
